europe_now.title: Finland summons Russian ambassador over airspace violation
europe_now.summary: Finland has officially summoned the Russian ambassador following a suspected helicopter incursion and airspace violation near its border.

europe_now.title: EU prepares new sanctions targeting Russian sectors
europe_now.summary: The European Union is advancing a fresh sanctions package that aims to target Russian ex-soldiers, banks, and sports organizations.

top_stories.title: Belgian national strike
top_stories.summary: Airports and public transport services were severely affected as a national strike paralyzed Belgium. Protests mounted across the country as workers demonstrated against various economic policies.

top_stories.title: Emissions trading policy debate
top_stories.summary: Eight EU member states have formally rejected any further delays to including transport and heating in emissions trading. The debate highlights ongoing divisions over the pace of the bloc's environmental reforms.
